req.title: Register requires password
req.statement: The system shall render the register form with an error message when POST /auth/register omits the password.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-005 requires that POST /auth/register renders the register form with 'Password is required.' when the password field is omitted. We need: (1) a positive case confirming the error message appears with HTTP 200 when password is missing but username is present; (2) a negative case confirming that a complete registration (username + password) succeeds with HTTP 302 redirect and no error; (3) a boundary case confirming that an empty-string password (distinct from omitting the key entirely) also triggers the same error. Additional tests cover the exact error string constant, the state transition from missing-password back to the register form, and the decision table distinguishing missing-password from missing-username errors.

tests.name: test_register_missing_password_shows_error
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
actions: POST /auth/register with username='newuser' and no password field
expected: Response body contains exactly 'Password is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-005: system shall render register form with error when password is omitted
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'newuser'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Password is required.' in r.data
assert b'Username is required.' not in r.data

def test_register_missing_password_shows_error():
    fd2, path2 = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd2)
    app2 = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path2})
    with app2.app_context():
        init_db()
    c = app2.test_client()
    resp = c.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'newuser'})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert b'Password is required.' in resp.data
    assert b'Username is required.' not in resp.data

tests.name: test_register_with_password_succeeds_no_error
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
expected: Response body does NOT contain 'Password is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-005: when password IS provided the error must NOT appear and registration succeeds
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_register_with_password_succeeds_no_error():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    c = app.test_client()
    resp = c.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'brandnew', 'password': 'secret123'})
    assert resp.status_code == 302
    assert resp.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
    assert b'Password is required.' not in resp.data

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

EXPECTED_ERROR = b'Password is required.'

def test_register_missing_password_exact_error_text_constant():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    c = app.test_client()
    resp = c.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'alice'})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert EXPECTED_ERROR in resp.data
    assert b'password is required.' not in resp.data
    assert b'Password is Required.' not in resp.data
    assert b'Password required.' not in resp.data

tests.name: test_register_missing_password_stays_on_register_page
preconditions: Flask app created with TESTING=True and a fresh temp database
actions: POST /auth/register with username='bob' and no password
Verify no redirect occurs (state stays on register form)
trace: R-FLASKR-005: system must NOT transition to login state when password is missing; state stays at register
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

def test_register_missing_password_stays_on_register_page():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        init_db()
    c = app.test_client()
    resp = c.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'bob'})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.status_code != 302
    location = resp.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/auth/login' not in location
    assert b'Password is required.' in resp.data
